info.name: NDUB Student Portal API
info.description:
Unofficial API documentation generated from observed NDUB Student Portal responses on 2026-10-27.

## Authentication
Run **Login** first. Its test script stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` as collection variables. All student API requests automatically use `accessToken`.

## Security
Keep credentials and tokens private. The examples are sanitized and contain no real student data.

## Stability
This is not a published NDUB API contract. Endpoints and response fields may change without notice.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Create and refresh the JWT session used by the protected student endpoints.

request.description: Authenticates a student. A successful response contains `data.accessToken` and `data.refreshToken`. The test script saves both as secret collection variables.
Gets a fresh session using the refresh token as the bearer credential. This endpoint does not accept an expired access token in place of the refresh token.
Returns `profileInfo`, `advisorInfo`, and `creditSummary`. Profile fields include student identity, program, department, academic status, and contact information.

response.name: Success

request.description: Returns `data.offeredCourses[]`. Each course includes IDs, code, title, type, category, credits, contact hours, syllabus, registration status, and section.

item.name: Semesters & Courses
item.description: Semester selection and registered course information.

request.description: Returns an array of available semesters with `semesterId`, name, type, label, value, and optional `isSemesterEnd`.

response.name: Success
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Request successful",
  "data": [
    {
      "semesterId": 33,
      "semesterName": "Example Semester",
      "semesterType": "Regular",
      "value": 33,
      "label": "Example Semester",
      "isSemesterEnd": false
    }
  ],
  "errors": null,
  "debugHint": null
}

item.name: Attendance
item.description: Semester-level attendance summaries and detailed class records.

query.description: Semester identifier returned by Get Semester List.

request.description: Returns student and semester metadata plus `attendanceSummary[]`. Each course summary includes present, absent, total-class counts, and percentage.

response.name: Success
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Request successful",
  "data": {
    "studentRoll": "STUDENT_ID",
    "studentName": "Example Student",

        "totalClass": 12,

  "errors": null,
  "debugHint": null
}

item.name: Routine
item.description: Weekly program schedule for a semester.

query.description: Semester identifier returned by Get Semester List.

request.description: Returns routine rows. Each row has a `periodId`, room information, and a `days` object keyed by weekday. A scheduled day contains section, program, course, faculty, and routine IDs.

response.name: Success
